question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word 'Flash' from the given sentence.

My cousin Zara, who loves to explore outer space in her free time, once noticed or observed a disc-shaped object blinking in the sky.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Flash"** means a sudden burst of light or to shine brightly and suddenly. (चमकना)

 
 
• **Example: **The camera's flash was so bright that it temporarily blinded everyone in the room.
 
 
 
• **"Blinking" **refers to shining intermittently or to flicker on and off. (टिमटिमाना)
 
 
• **Example: **The blinking lights of the airplane could be seen from miles away.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Flash' **is **'blinking'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. 'blinking'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Noticed **(ध्यान दिया): To become aware of something or someone.

 
 
• **Example:** She noticed a small detail that everyone else missed.
 
 
 
• **Observed **(देखा): To watch carefully, especially with attention to details.
 
 
• **Example: **The scientist observed the behavior of the animals in their natural habitat.
 
 
 
• **Explore** (खोज करना): To travel through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it.
 
 
• **Example:** She loves to explore new places during her vacations.
